'''Lurts''' is a [[Saldaean]] soldier.

== Appearance ==
He is a massive wall of a man.

== Activities ==
He goes with [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] when she tries to track down the messenger boy, who was sent by King [[Alsalam Saeed Almadar]] to [[Milisair Chadmar]]. He guards the back door to prevent anyone from escaping, and catches [[Kerb]] as he tries to slip out.
